newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan parties to aim for quick budget passage-Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Japan parties to aim for quick budget passage-Jiji.

text.p: Japan's ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) and two other parties forming a loose alliance with it agreed on Tuesday to promote reforms and aim for early parliamentary approval of state budgets to tackle a sharp decline in stock prices, Jiji news agency said.

The three parties agreed to push for structural reforms and early approval of the supplementary budget for this fiscal year ending March 31, 1997, Jiji said. They also agreed to aim for passage of the full 1997/98 budget through parliament by the end of March, the news agency said.
The stock market has been falling on worries about the effect of a forthcoming fiscal tightening on the economy and on scepticism about the government's commitment to reform.
